original_en:
Did you notice the lamps on the roads?
Their light burns by magic. <PART>
---
Dipan has three powerful sorcerers
known as the Three Mages. <PART>
---
Here in Dipan, we enjoy a better life than
others, all thanks to the Three Mages.
